hypothesis: Among five liquid Binance USDT markets, the perpetual contract with the largest contemporaneous spot-minus-perpetual log basis outperforms the contract with the smallest basis over the following 24 hours strongly enough for an equal-notional long-high-basis/short-low-basis spread to remain profitable after actual funding, taker fees, and modeled slippage.

provenance.reason: Perpetual premium and funding are mechanically related, so this is a daily price-basis transfer test inside the same broad crowding/funding-dispersion family, not an independent source of diversification.

research_basis.source: Chi, Hao, Hu and Ran (2023), An empirical investigation on risk factors in cryptocurrency futures
research_basis.finding: On 12 OKEx current-quarter futures from 2017 to 2021, daily high-minus-low basis portfolios were strongest at a one-day horizon and survived the paper's five-basis-point transaction-cost assumption.
research_basis.transfer_limit: Current-quarter contracts converge at expiry; Binance perpetuals instead use funding. The mechanism and reported magnitude must not be assumed to transfer.

research_basis.source: Schmeling, Schrimpf and Todorov, Crypto Carry
research_basis.finding: Crypto basis is persistent but risky and constrained by arbitrage capital and funding liquidity.
research_basis.transfer_limit: The paper primarily studies fixed-maturity carry, not the directional perpetual cross-section tested here.

research_basis.finding: Official archives are the required source for any prospective successor test.
research_basis.transfer_limit: The local historical feather files are discovery-quality and are not publisher-manifest-bound evidence for live promotion.

development.boundary_amendment: The first attempted run stopped before ranking or PnL because the 2021-12-31 23:00 spot signal candle is absent. The first decision is therefore the earliest one with all five completed 23:00 signal candles; no return was observed before this amendment.
development.role: historical transfer diagnostic; it may reject the idea but can never authorize live trading
development.data_source: existing local Binance spot, USD-M perpetual, mark-price and funding-rate 1h feather files
development.survivorship_warning: The five symbols are today's surviving liquid names, not a point-in-time universe.
development.historical_validation: none; if development passes, the only permitted successor is a newly preregistered forward test using the point-in-time universe after its coverage gate matures

fixed_signal_and_execution.decision_schedule: 00:00 UTC every day beginning 2022-01-02, the first boundary with all required prior signal candles
fixed_signal_and_execution.signal_prices: the close of the fully completed 23:00-00:00 UTC spot and perpetual 1h candles
fixed_signal_and_execution.long: highest basis score; alphabetical symbol breaks an exact tie
fixed_signal_and_execution.short: lowest basis score; alphabetical symbol breaks an exact tie
fixed_signal_and_execution.entry: next 1h candle open at 01:00 UTC, one full hour after the decision boundary
fixed_signal_and_execution.exit: 01:00 UTC the following day unless an individual leg reaches its adverse 10% protection stop

cost_and_accounting.funding: actual funding event rate times contemporaneous mark-price notional; a long pays positive funding and a short receives it
cost_and_accounting.mark_to_market: hourly with adverse exit slippage and fees

interpretation.pass: Only authorizes design of a fresh point-in-time forward protocol; does not count as OOS or live evidence.
interpretation.fail: Closes family trial 3 without threshold, time, universe, stop, cost, or sizing changes.
interpretation.monthly_target: The 0.5% development sleeve hurdle is not the platform's 10% portfolio objective. Leverage may not be used to bridge that gap.

prohibited: describing Alpha 014 as independent from Alpha 009 or Alpha 013
opening a historical validation interval after seeing development
changing the daily schedule, basis definition, direction, 24-hour hold, stop, costs, sizing, or five-symbol universe after seeing results
adding a basis threshold or funding filter after seeing results
dropping a losing day, symbol, or leg
using the fixed surviving-symbol sample as live-promotion evidence
raising leverage to manufacture the 10% monthly objective
